title: Shielded benchmark profiles for Dedicated customers (encrypted golden artifacts + change-triggered micro-evals)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a first-class capability for Dedicated and Private deployments that lets customers maintain "shielded" benchmark profiles: encrypted golden artifacts stored in customer-controlled buckets, a small suite of change-triggered micro-evals that run on config/model flips, and a privacy-preserving telemetry mode. Goals: reduce noisy false positives on regressions, avoid sending PII to central eval infra, and provide deterministic canary gates tied to model or runtime config changes.
acceptance_criteria: Customers can register a benchmark profile that references encrypted golden artifacts stored in a customer-owned S3/GCS path
On model version change or runtime-config flip, the platform runs the customer micro-eval suite in an isolated sandbox (no telemetry by default) and produces a pass/fail signal
Platform exposes a per-profile summary (latency cost delta, quality delta w.r.t. goldens) in Console and an API hook for canary gating
Telemetry from shielded runs is optional and, when enabled, is redacted and routed through a customer-approved collector
Docs and a quickstart guide for Dedicated/Private admins with step-by-step instructions and example golden artifact formats
comments: 2026-02-21: Kickoff with ENG and Security. Agreed that golden artifacts must be AES-256 encrypted at rest and uploaded to customer buckets; platform will only store URI + checksum.
2026-02-28: Design review (DES-1792) suggested a minimal micro-eval harness (<=50 queries) to keep cost/latency acceptable for pre-rollout gating.
2026-03-03: Engineering flagged dependency on KV-cache snapshot API (ENG-19876) to reproduce deterministic contexts for micro-evals.
2026-03-07: Security requested a threat model for telemetry opt-in flow; flagged as prerequisite for any non-redacted reporting.
2026-03-10: PM decision: Default mode is 'no-telemetry' for shielded profiles; customers may opt into aggregated telemetry via a signed consent flow. Next: draft PRD linked below.
